command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out && cd /tmp/out
# GMTKN55 (Goerigk et al., PCCP 19, 32184 (2017), doi:10.1039/C7CP04913G) from the Grimme group's own
# repository, at the v1-branch commit that preserves the publication: grimme-lab/GMTKN55 8d485b37.
# Fetched on AWS. The commit id is the durable pin (git's archive carries it, checked below); the sha256
# of the copy kept in the bucket is the byte pin.
C=8d485b37a1ca8837e395042671ca5ba4e0714691
python3 -u - "$C" <<'PYEOF' || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
import sys, tarfile, urllib.request
c = sys.argv[1]
req = urllib.request.Request("https://codeload.github.com/grimme-lab/GMTKN55/tar.gz/" + c, headers={"User-Agent": "curl/8"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r, open("gmtkn55-v1.tar.gz", "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(r.read())
with tarfile.open("gmtkn55-v1.tar.gz") as t:
    names = t.getnames()
    print("archive commit:", t.pax_headers.get("comment"))
    assert t.pax_headers.get("comment") == c, "archive is not commit " + c
coords = [n for n in names if n.endswith("/coord")]
res = [n for n in names if n.endswith("/.res")]
print("members", len(names), "coord", len(coords), ".res", len(res))
assert len(coords) == 2462, "expected GMTKN55's 2462 structures"
PYEOF
sha256sum gmtkn55-v1.tar.gz | tee gmtkn55-v1.sha256
ls -l
echo DONE
